description: Cancel one of the connected traveller's bookings in two steps. Step 1: call with booking_id only. Nothing changes; you receive consequences (the exact refund and any amount kept) and a consent_token. Show message_for_user and the amounts to the traveller and ask them to confirm. Do this every time; never decide for them. Step 2: only after they explicitly agree, call again with booking_id and consent_token. If the result is TERMS_CHANGED the numbers moved: show the new ones and ask again. Never call a cancellation free: a paid booking keeps a processing fee. Only report success when cancelled is true; cancelled null means the outcome is not yet known. Without a connected account this returns the secure emailed-link instructions instead and cancels nothing.

consent_token.description: Only on step 2, and only after the traveller explicitly agreed to the consequences from step 1.

name: cancel_booking

outputSchema.description: A disclosure with a consent_token, or the outcome of the cancellation.

cancelled.description: true = cancelled; false = nothing was cancelled; null = not yet known.

code.description: CONSENT_REQUIRED, TERMS_CHANGED, or why it did not complete.

consent_token.description: Present only with the terms it applies to.

consequences.description: Exact refund, amount kept and message_for_user.

title: Cancel a Tell & Go booking, with the traveller's consent
